verdict.rationale: The docs touch on the security posture only in passing. Skills can bundle optional scripts alongside instructions, which hints at what they can execute. Curated and experimental skill sources, plus a submission portal for public plugin review, imply a basic trust tier for third-party content. On data, Sign in with ChatGPT shares only name, email and profile picture and does not grant data access or approve actions automatically. None of this amounts to a documented security posture. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the skill execution model or sandbox and what scripts are permitted to do, a documented trust model and vetting criteria for third-party or marketplace skills, telemetry or data-collection disclosure for plugins and skills, and independent corroboration.
